messages.content: Cypress called about the spa booking. The therapist for the 1:00 Saturday treatment is unavailable. They offered to move both of us to Sunday morning, keep the 10:30 Saturday treatment and waitlist the second, or remove one treatment. I need to decide while the room is still cancellable.

What exact Sunday times did they offer, and are those treatments consecutive or simultaneous? Also, what is already fixed for Saturday and Sunday? I will compare the disruption, then check the $250 package credit and the treatment amount before changing anything.

Sunday would be 9:00 and 10:30, consecutive, both 80 minutes. We have a 12:30 lunch reservation in Carmel on Saturday and planned Point Lobos afterward. Sunday is open until a 1:00 whale-watching departure from Monterey. We need to check in by 12:15.

The Sunday arrangement is workable but tight. The first treatment would end around 10:20 and the second around 11:50, leaving only 25 minutes to reach the 12:15 check-in. That does not allow for changing, a delayed treatment, or traffic. Saturday is also awkward if one treatment remains at 10:30: it ends near 11:50, leaving about 40 minutes to reach the Carmel lunch, while the person waiting for the 1:00 slot would have no certainty.
Could we move the whale-watching check-in later? The operator says 12:30 is the absolute cutoff, but the boat still leaves at 1:00.

That improves the margin only slightly. From an 11:50 treatment finish, you would have about 40 minutes to change, leave Cypress, park near the harbor, and check in. I would not pair those Sunday appointments with the cruise unless Cypress can move them earlier or shorten the second treatment without changing the credit.

They cannot move them earlier. A 50-minute second treatment could finish at 11:30, but it would reduce that treatment from $306 to $238 all-in. Please work through the money. The spa representative was unclear about whether losing one treatment also loses the room credit.

The current accounting is $612 for two 80-minute treatments, less the single $250 package credit, so $362 net. If Sunday becomes one 80-minute treatment at $306 and one 50-minute treatment at $238, the spa total is $544. With the full credit preserved, the net spa amount would be $294 and the trip total would fall from $2,547.08 to $2,479.08. Before accepting, Cypress needs to confirm in writing that the $250 credit remains valid with mixed treatment lengths and identify which treatment receives it.

They have now confirmed that the credit can be used against either treatment as long as both are charged to the room. If we remove the unavailable treatment instead, the remaining 80-minute treatment keeps the full $250 credit. They also said the removed treatment would be ‘refunded.’ We have not paid the spa yet, though.

Then ‘refunded’ should mean a $306 reduction to the spa folio, not money returned to a card. With only the Saturday 10:30 treatment, the charge would be $306 less the $250 credit, or $56 net. The revised expected trip total would be $2,241.08: $2,045.08 room, $140 parking, and $56 net spa. Ask them to state that no cancellation fee applies and that the second treatment will not appear on the folio.
Compare that with taking the shortened Sunday schedule. I do not want to preserve the room booking merely because of a credit if the weekend no longer works.

Keeping one Saturday treatment is the lowest-cost option, but it no longer delivers the two-person wellness plan and puts pressure on the 12:30 lunch. The Sunday 80-minute plus 50-minute schedule preserves treatments for both of you and saves $68, but an 11:30 finish leaves one hour for changing and reaching the harbor by 12:30. That is feasible with a prompt departure, though still dependent on treatments starting on time. Canceling Cypress remains available through May 21 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific, but it would require replacing the four-night stay and forfeiting this package structure rather than merely solving the spa issue.

Take the Sunday option with the second treatment shortened to 50 minutes. Move the credit to the 80-minute treatment. Keep the room and cruise, and have Cypress note that both appointments must start on time. What are the final figures and deadlines?

Cypress is revised to Sunday, May 31: an 80-minute treatment at 9:00 a.m. and a 50-minute treatment at 10:30 a.m., with the $250 room credit applied to the 80-minute treatment. The spa total is $544 all-in and $294 after the credit. The revised expected trip total is $2,479.08: $2,045.08 room, $140 parking, and $294 net spa. The existing $946.40 room deposit remains unchanged. Cypress has noted timely starts; plan to leave immediately after the 11:30 finish for the whale-watching check-in by 12:30. The room can still be canceled through May 21 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific. The revised spa appointments remain separately cancellable through May 28 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific. Retain the amended spa confirmation showing both Sunday times, treatment lengths, all-in prices, credit assignment, and removal of the Saturday appointments without a fee.

Keep all reservations unchanged and use the confirmed $72 Tuesday luggage service around the 8:00 a.m.-4:00 p.m. facility visit; retain the authorization, tracking record, and delivery receipt. Friday checkout and bag storage still require execution as planned. Fairmont Sonoma is booked, with written confirmation of the Sunday facial outstanding before May 10. Bothell, Chicago, and Carlsbad are booked, with noted confirmations and reimbursement records pending. Scottsdale November 6-10 remains selected but unbooked. Palm Springs November 14-18 is paid; corrected resort documentation remains outstanding. Cypress Spa Lodge remains booked for May 28-June 1 under room confirmation CYP-52841. Spa confirmation SPA-53026 is revised to Sunday, May 31, with an 80-minute treatment at 9:00 a.m. and a 50-minute treatment at 10:30 a.m.; both Saturday appointments were removed without a fee. The $250 room credit applies to the 80-minute treatment. Revised expected total is $2,479.08: $2,045.08 room, $140 parking, and $544 for treatments, less the $250 credit. The $946.40 room deposit and 9:30 p.m. Thursday arrival note remain unchanged. The room is cancellable through May 21 at 6:00 p.m. Pacific; revised treatments are cancellable through May 28 at 9:00 a.m. Pacific. Leave promptly after the 11:30 Sunday treatment finish for the whale-watching check-in by 12:30. Retain the room confirmation, amended spa confirmation, deposit receipt, and final folio documenting parking and credit application.
